newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-THREE-GAME SUSPENSION FOR SIMEONE FOR DANGEROUS PLAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-THREE-GAME SUSPENSION FOR SIMEONE FOR DANGEROUS PLAY.

text.p: The Spanish Federation disciplinary committee has suspended Atletico Madrid's Diego Simeone for three games for stamping on Julen Guerrero's leg during a league match against Athletic Bilbao.
The midfielder, who was also fined 100,000 pesetas ($769), will miss the Spanish champions' vital derby game with arch-rivals Real Sociedad this weekend.
With Milinko Pantic and Jose Luis Caminero already out through injury, Atletico coach Radomir Antic will have to draw on replacement midfielders from the club's reserve side.
